test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 09 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate collocating word to fill in the blank.**

The girl has ________ chances of winning the match.
solution: The correct answer is option 2), i.e., 'high.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the meaning of the words given in the options: Word Meaning bountiful large in amount. (प्रचुर) high greater than the usual level or amount. (उच्च संभावना) light not heavy. (हलका) hefty large and heavy. (बड़ा और भारी) • According to the context of the sentence the word "chances" is often used with the adjective "high" to denote a strong possibility of something happening, which is appropriate to describe the chances of winning a match. • According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is "high." • Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2. • Another example: • *There seemed to be a **high** probability of success.* Complete Sentence:__ *The girl has *__*high*__* chances of winning the match.* * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__*** • A **collocation **is two or more words that often go together. These combinations just sound "right" to native English speakers, who use them all the time. • **Examples:** A quick meal, a quick shower, completely satisfied etc. 181:T24e1,
